title: Smart Tree Feller
description: Cut down entire trees by breaking the bottom log with an axe its that easy :3
body:
Smart Tree Feller lets you chop down an entire tree by breaking the bottom log with an axe.

---

### Features
- Axe-only detection
- Prevents breaking player-built structures
- Smart tree detection to avoid false positives
- Simple toggle keybind

---

Client-side mod. Works on vanilla servers.
